title: Enterprise Connectivity: signed earlier corrections
content:
## Application
Enterprise Connectivity applies this signed earlier corrections rule to assisted correction posting.

## Basis: earlier
For assisted correction posting, sum the signed net service subtotal of posted correction credits and posted correction debit adjustments linked to selected original charge; service-credit concessions, nonfinancial reviews and adjustments for other source charges are excluded.

## Basis Q&A
| Assisted correction posting basis | Consequence for this action |
| --- | --- |
| Assisted correction posting: Sum the signed net service subtotal of posted correction credits and posted correction debit adjustments linked to selected original charge | service-credit concessions, nonfinancial reviews and adjustments for other source charges are excluded. |
